comment: The app's fonts, in one place. Each face names the family the native app draws with on each platform (`family`), the CSS stack the catalog, the web views and the imported themes use (`stack`), the font files to bundle from assets/fonts (`files`, empty for system fonts) and the advance of "0" per em at each weight (`zeroAdvance`; measured from the running fonts, these are the fallback before measuring). To switch fonts: edit this file; for bundled files also run python3 tools/generate-assets-rs.py; then re-run the importers that tools/system-fonts.mjs names (their --check fails until you do).
